title: Voice of the Once-Spoken
content:
The Exclusive Rescreening channel is now available for a limited time only. Use Encrypted Master Tapes to Signal Search.
This Exclusive Rescreening includes: Voice of the Once-Spoken, Whispered Tales, and Per Aspera.
Currently selected: Voice of the Once-Spoken. The Signal Search reception rate for the limited S-Rank Agent Dialyn is boosted!
In the Voice of the Once-Spoken channel, Proxies cannot obtain the other two limited S-Rank Agents from this period through Signal Search. If you wish to change the rate-up Agent, please go to the Signal Search interface and switch to the corresponding tab.
※ The limited S-Rank Agent above will not become available in the Star-Studded Cast Stable Channel.
※Proxies can use the Custom Search function to customize the non-rate-up S-Rank Agents.
※This event Channel is open for a limited time only. All featured Signals may go live again in the future.
※ This channel is an Exclusive Rescreening channel. The Search count for guaranteed Signals is cumulative across all Exclusive Rescreening channels but is independent of and unaffected by other types of Channels.
※ The guarantee system in Exclusive Rescreening channels includes both Special Guarantee and the standard guarantee. Please refer to [Exclusive Rescreening Special Notes] and [Exclusive Rescreening Signal Search] below for the detailed rules.

〓Exclusive Rescreening Special Notes〓
[20% Discount on First 10-Signal Searches]
During each Exclusive Rescreening period, the first 10-Signal Searches will be 20% off, consuming only Encrypted Master Tape ×8. From the 2nd 10-Signal Searches onwards, the number of Encrypted Master Tapes required will return to the original amount.
This offer applies to all channels in the current Exclusive Rescreening and can only be applied once during the current period. Changing the rate-up Agent will not reset the discount.
This discount resets with each Exclusive Rescreening update, and unused discounts will not carry over to the next period.
※ Discount only applies to 10-Signal Searches, and single Signal Searches are not discounted.
[Rate-Up Agent Guaranteed on First S-Rank Signal]
During the Exclusive Rescreening period, the first S-Rank Signal obtained in this channel is guaranteed to be the currently selected limited S-Rank Agent (this guarantee mechanism is hereinafter referred to as "Special Guarantee").
This Special Guarantee applies to all channels in the current Exclusive Rescreening and can only trigger once during the current period. Changing the rate-up Agent will not reset the Special Guarantee.
This guarantee resets with each Exclusive Rescreening update, and untriggered guarantee counts will not carry over to the next period.
[Standard Guarantee Carry-Over]
The Special Guarantee for Exclusive Rescreening channels is calculated separately from the standard guarantee, and they do not affect each other.
In the Exclusive Rescreening channels, when obtaining an S-Rank Agent for the first time, the Special Guarantee will be triggered first. After the Special Guarantee is triggered, subsequent S-Rank Agent signals will follow the standard guarantee rules (see [Exclusive Rescreening Signal Search] below).
※ The standard guarantee counter in the Exclusive Rescreening channels will continue to accumulate. For example: If a Proxy triggers the Special Guarantee in the current Exclusive Rescreening period, continues to Signal Search and obtains a non-limited S-Rank Agent, then in the next Exclusive Rescreening period, the first two S-Rank Signals obtained will be the selected limited S-Rank Agent.

〓Exclusive Rescreening Signal Search〓
[S-Rank Signals]
In the current Exclusive Rescreening channel, the base probability of an S-Rank Agent is 0.600%. Within 90 Signal Searches, at least one S-Rank Agent is guaranteed. The overall probability of an S-Rank Agent (including the guarantee) is 1.600%. The combined probability (including the guarantee) for the selected limited S-Rank Agent is 1.067% (only applies to standard guarantee, and the Special Guarantee is not included in the combined probability for limited S-Rank Agents).
After triggering the Special Guarantee, when an S-Rank Agent is obtained through this Signal Search, there is a 50.000% probability that the S-Rank Signal obtained is the selected limited S-Rank Agent. If the S-Rank Agent obtained is not the selected limited S-Rank Agent, then the next S-Rank Agent obtained is guaranteed to be the selected limited S-Rank Agent Dialyn.
[A-Rank Signals]
In the current Exclusive Rescreening, the base probability of an A-Rank Signal is 9.400%, where the base probability for an A-Rank Agent is 4.700% and the base probability for an A-Rank W-Engine is 4.700%. Within 10 Signal Searches, at least one A-Rank or higher Signal is guaranteed. The overall probability of A-Rank Signals (including the guarantee) is 14.400%.

〓 Special Notes 〓
Residual Signals, Fading Signals, and Special Invitation Letters can be obtained when Signal Searching in the current Channel. You can exchange Residual Signals and Fading Signals for items in the Signal Shop, and exchange Special Invitation Letters for items in the Collectible Exchange. See below for details:
[Obtaining an S-Rank Signal]
• The 2nd to 7th copies of an S-Rank Agent will be converted into Agent Focus ×1 and Residual Signal ×40. From the 8th copy onwards, Agents will be converted into Special Invitation Letter ×1 and Residual Signal ×100.
[Obtaining an A-Rank Signal]
• The 2nd to 7th copies of an A-Rank Agent will be converted into Agent Focus ×1 and Residual Signal ×8. From the 8th copy onwards, Agents will be converted into Residual Signal ×20.
• Each A-Rank W-Engine obtained in the current Channel will also grant Residual Signal ×8.
[Obtaining a B-Rank Signal]
• Each B-Rank W-Engine obtained in the current Channel will also grant Fading Signal ×20.
